name: Sukumizu Police
source:
There is a prestigious girls school where students in swimsuits train all year long. There is also a mysterious organization that hinders swimming activity. Sukumizu Police - a group of five girls - stand up to protect everyone's treasured pastime.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一所著名女子学校，学生们全年穿着泳装训练。还有一个神秘组织不断妨碍游泳活动。为了守护大家珍视的爱好，由5名少女组成的“校园泳装警察”挺身而出。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
